description: A wav sample player and recorder, with cue and loop cursors, a four-stage envelope, overdubbing and polyphonic pitch tracking

notes: nothing plays until a sample is loaded or recorded: right-click the panel and use Load Sample, or right-click the waveform display.
recording needs a cable in the left recording input; with that jack empty the REC button and its triggers do nothing.
recording is monophonic, so the module drops to one voice while REC is on and the record head follows channel 0 of the V/Oct cable.
loaded samples are always resampled to Rack's working rate, so the interpolation is fixed to Hermite and the Interpolation menu item of sickoPlayer is not offered here.
the display shows the recording time and a yellow S while a recorded sample has not been saved.
menu: Load Sample — opens a file chooser for the sample this module plays
Save FULL Sample — writes the whole sample to a wav file
Save CUE Region — writes the part between the cue cursors to a wav file
Save LOOP Region — writes the part between the loop cursors to a wav file
Trim Sample after Save — keeps only the saved part in memory afterwards, instead of keeping the whole sample
Save Oversampled — writes the file at the module's internal rate, twice Rack's, for editing elsewhere
Select Samples Root — picks a folder, after which a Samples Browser submenu appears for loading
Anti-aliasing filter — adds two-times oversampling and a 20kHz lowpass before the outputs
Polyphonic OUTs — carries the V/Oct polyphony through to the outputs; with it off every voice is summed into single-channel outputs
Polyphonic Master IN — lets the MASTER CV jack take a polyphonic cable matching the V/Oct channels, for per-voice velocity
EOC pulse from — a submenu of eight points, each ticked or not, at which the EOC output sends a pulse: TRG/GATE (stop), STOP trig, CUE END, CUE START, LOOP END, LOOP START, PING and PONG
UCE/ULE update also Start — makes the UCE and ULE buttons move the start cursors as well as the end ones
Crossfade while Rec Fading — crossfades between the old and new recording during the record fade, when overdub is off
Reset cursors on Load — puts the cue and loop cursors back to 0% and 100% whenever a new sample is loaded
Disable NAV Buttons — stops the panel navigation buttons from loading anything, so they cannot be pressed by accident
Store Sample in Patch — saves the loaded sample inside the patch file, which can make it very large
Unlimited REC (risky) — lifts the memory ceiling on recording, at the risk of a crash on a recording the machine cannot hold
Presets: Wavetable, Triggered Sample with Envelope, Drum Player — sets the cursors, mode and envelope in one go for one of three common uses
